const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint-strict trajectory driver for the live eai-standard/2.2 episode.
+
+This file intentionally has no reset logic. Run the calibration phase once, inspect
+the practice sheet, then use the same helpers for the main-sheet strokes.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+RUNS = OUT / 'runs'
+RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+DT = 0.05
+
+
+def interpolate_waypoints(start, waypoints, speed=0.06):
+    """Sample xyz/quaternion waypoints at 20 Hz, keeping commands below speed."""
+    poses = []
+    prev = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
+    for wp in waypoints:
+        end = np.asarray(wp, dtype=float)
+        dist = float(np.linalg.norm(end[:3] - prev[:3]))
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / (speed * DT))))
+        for i in range(1, n + 1):
+            f = i / n
+            # Calibration and writing keep the vertical orientation fixed.
+            p = prev.copy()
+            p[:3] = prev[:3] + f * (end[:3] - prev[:3])
+            p[3:] = DOWN
+            poses.append(p)
+        prev = end
+    return np.asarray(poses, dtype=np.float32), prev
+
+
+def execute(r, current, waypoints, note, run_name, cams=('canvas_cam', 'practice_cam', 'side_cam'), speed=0.06):
+    rows, end = interpolate_waypoints(current, waypoints, speed=speed)
+    if len(rows) > 400:
+        raise ValueError(f'{note}: {len(rows)} rows exceeds submit limit')
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', rows, dt=DT, cameras=list(cams), video='both', video_fps=8, note=note)
+    res.save(str(RUNS / run_name))
+    print(note, 'rows=', len(rows), 'plan=', res.meta.get('plan'), 'status=', r.status())
+    return end, res
+
+
+def calibrate():
+    r = Robot()
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam', 'practice_cam', 'side_cam'])
+    current = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14], dtype=float)
+    print('start tip', current, 'status', r.status())
+    # The scene/depth calibration places the ink well at about (-0.098, 0.1555)
+    # with its surface near z=0.0285 m. Dip below that surface, then lift clear.
+    ink = (-0.098, 0.1555)
+    current, _ = execute(r, current, [
+        [ink[0], ink[1], 0.10, *DOWN],
+        [ink[0], ink[1], 0.018, *DOWN],
+        [ink[0], ink[1], 0.018, *DOWN],
+        [ink[0], ink[1], 0.10, *DOWN],
+    ], 'dip ink', 'cal_00_dip', speed=0.04)
+
+    # Three short parallel lines on the unscored practice sheet, at 3, 8 and
+    # 13 mm of tip penetration. Lines run along the sheet's X axis.
+    for i, (x, z) in enumerate([(-0.072, 0.017), (-0.100, 0.012), (-0.128, 0.007)], 1):
+        current, _ = execute(r, current, [
+            [x, -0.225, 0.10, *DOWN],
+            [x, -0.225, z, *DOWN],
+            [x, -0.158, z, *DOWN],
+            [x, -0.158, 0.10, *DOWN],
+        ], f'practice width test {i}', f'cal_{i:02d}_line', cams=('practice_cam', 'side_cam'), speed=0.045)
+
+    # Clear the practice camera's view and return to a safe, elevated pose.
+    current, _ = execute(r, current, [[0.0, 0.0, 0.20, *DOWN]], 'clear practice sheet', 'cal_04_clear')
+    print('calibration complete; tip', current, 'status', r.status())
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    calibrate()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
